linkedin:
> Listmonk is a high-performance, open-source, self-hosted newsletter and mailing list manager, shipped as a single Go binary backed by PostgreSQL.

It manages subscribers, lists, templates, and campaigns from its own dashboard, and it is refreshingly light to run. The catch to understand first: listmonk does not send email itself. It hands campaigns to an SMTP server or Amazon SES, so you still need a real sending path and real deliverability setup (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, sender reputation).

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/self-host-listmonk/
